mentions.name: KeyStash
mentions.description: KeyStash is a Linux SSH key and user management system. The current work is onsite (self-hosted) deployment support, using RPMs, Debs, and Docker with the goal of making setup as close to a '5 step process' as possible while reducing support load.
mentions.problem: Many customers want to run the system themselves rather than use hosted infrastructure, but onsite deployment is harder to make slick and easy than a managed service.
mentions.audience: DevOps and customers who want to self-host the platform on their own infrastructure
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on onsite deployments for https://www.keystash.io, which is a Linux SSH Key and User management system.
